reviewer.independence_basis: Separate reviewer agent session. Findings were based on direct file inspection, read-only host observations, artifact hash checks, and an independent local rebuild; author conclusions were not treated as proof.

code_candidate_evidence: Protected root staging copies are hashed before installation; installed artifacts are hashed again.
Existing dedicated identity, paths, unit and drop-in are rejected; concurrent installation is locked.
Listener query failures and effective systemd property query failures do not pass as successful empty results.
Effective systemd fragment, drop-ins, user, group, command and environment are checked before enable/start.
Failure and INT/TERM cleanup stop and disable the armed service while preserving state.
Binary, script, unit, tokens and policy hashes matched the candidate manifest; bash syntax validation passed.

independent_rebuild.source_evidence: Commit e3b022f to 75087de changed only the candidate JSON. During rebuild, uncommitted changes were documentation only; Go sources, module definitions and embedded static assets had no differences from e3b022f.

host_install_pending_reasons: Concurrent k3s shutdown and libvirt work require coordination with Yu or the responsible operator before transfer or installation.
A fresh host baseline and workload impact check immediately before installation are outstanding.
Existing public reachability paths require verification; unknown paths must not be treated as proof of private readiness.
Candidate, policy, artifact identity and expiry must be rechecked for the actual operation.

limitations.host_access: Read-only SSH inspection only; no installation, service mutation, reboot, or transfer was performed by this reviewer.
limitations.authorization_boundary: The code_candidate allow is a local technical review outcome, not permission to transfer, install, start services, reboot, publish, or modify remote state. A separate operation-level decision is required after outstanding conditions are resolved.
